    """Fit two linear segments and return the intersection point and R^2"""
    if split_idx < 10 or split_idx > len(temps) - 10:
        return None, 0
    
    # High temperature segment (liquid)
    T_high = temps[:split_idx]
    rho_high = densities[:split_idx]

        rho_low_pred = np.polyval(p_low, T_low)
        
        ss_res_high = np.sum((rho_high - rho_high_pred)**2)
        ss_tot_high = np.sum((rho_high - np.mean(rho_high))**2)
        r2_high = 1 - (ss_res_high / ss_tot_high) if ss_tot_high > 0 else 0
        
        ss_res_low = np.sum((rho_low - rho_low_pred)**2)
        ss_tot_low = np.sum((rho_low - np.mean(rho_low))**2)
        r2_low = 1 - (ss_res_low / ss_tot_low) if ss_tot_low > 0 else 0
        
        # Average R^2
        avg_r2 = (r2_high + r2_low) / 2
        
        # Find intersection: p_high[0]*T + p_high[1] = p_low[0]*T + p_low[1]
        if abs(p_high[0] - p_low[0]) < 1e-10:
            return None, 0
        
        T_intersect = (p_low[1] - p_high[1]) / (p_high[0] - p_low[0])
        
        return T_intersect, avg_r2
    except:

best_split = None
